name: CombinedX AB (publ)
summary: Established in Karlstad, Sweden, in 1993, CombinedX AB (publ) delivers a comprehensive suite of consulting services centered around digitalization. The firm assists organizations with a wide array of digital initiatives, including strategic digital business development and transformation, refining service design and customer journeys, optimizing business systems and processes, and leveraging data analytics for insightful decision support. Furthermore, their expertise extends to automation and robotization, the entire lifecycle of application development, enhancing the digital workplace and identity management, providing managed infrastructure and robust security solutions, and implementing Internet of Things technologies.
